observations.behavior: Adds a new workflow and activity queue, 'SYNC_EVENTS_RETENTION_WORKFLOWS' and 'SYNC_EVENTS_RETENTION_ACTIVITIES', to the ANALYTICS_PLATFORM_TASK_QUEUE, alongside existing workflows.
observations.posthog_connection: This configuration change assigns the new retention workflow to the Analytics Platform task queue, suggesting it is a backend process for retention data, rather than a general-purpose task.

observations.behavior: Updates the schedule for the new workflow to use the ANALYTICS_PLATFORM_TASK_QUEUE instead of GENERAL_PURPOSE_TASK_QUEUE.
observations.posthog_connection: This scheduling change aligns the workflow execution with the queue identified in P1.F1.H1, establishing the execution path for the retention schedule.
